question: Where must worship proceed after honoring the central presence?
premises: Worship is performed in the very center of all.
After central worship, further worship continues outward.
The next locations are the front corners on left and right.
inference: Therefore, after worshipping at the center, the practitioner must worship from the front left and right corners.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the central presence depends on the preceding ritual context.
plain_english: Having worshipped thoroughly in the very middle, one should then worship from the front corners on the left and right.
